name: The Algaz Gauntlet
objectiveText: Traverse Dun Algaz. Kill 8 Dragonmaw Scouts and 6 Dragonmaw Grunts . Report to Valstag Ironjaw in Menethil Harbor.   Dragonmaw Scout slain  ( 8 )   Dragonmaw Grunt slain  ( 6 )   Explore Zone  ( 1 )   Traverse Dun Algaz  ( 1 )

comments.body: "traverse Dun Algaz" aka continue down the road to wetlands

This quest is rather easy.  Go through the tunnel and on the left there is a camp of said orcs.  They can be pulled one at a time, just be careful as they are runners.  To complete the satisfy objective, just continue through the rest of the tunnels until you reach the wetlands.  Then onto Menthril Harbor to turn in.
replies: Also be careful of the ones with shields (grunts I think). They shield slam the hell out of you. This not only interrupts any casting but knocks you over as well. Having been unlucky enough to be fighting three at the same time, I couldn't even get off a 1.5 sec cast Gift of the Naaru.

You cannot pull the GRUNTS one at a time. They're too close together. If you are just 20 or poorly geared, your best bet is to get the ones close to the tunnels and wait for them to respawn as you need to. Or run from Loch Modan's graveyard back to your corpse.

comments.body: This took a while with my 21 mage because I kept getting jumped by multiple guys when I made my way in to the grunts.  Then I'd have to run/blink out and have to kill most of the scouts to get back in which took time.  I figured out if you are facing the camp to the right you can go up on the side of the hill (just time the scout movements so you can stay far enough away from them), then cross the big fallen tree to the left side and get to the grunts by staying up on the left side of the hill away from the scouts.  It's kind of a back door approach that got me the last of the grunts.  Just try to pull them up the hill one by one.  Unfortunately for some reason I got to the harbor and didn't satisfy the traverse part of the quest so no clue what happened there.
replies: A great trick! No problem getting all the grunts this way at lvl 22 warlock

comments.body:
If you had trouble on the Algaz Gauntlet, and you could not get the question mark yellow... check the quest.  It says you have to traverse the whole trail... and if you did like me... and had to go back to Loch Modan and flew.... then you didn't get credit for completing the task.. go back to the point of the fight... at least... then finish the tunnel out and the question mark will be yellow... I did, and it worked fine...  It's picky but it's the quest.. You can look at your quest log and if it does not say complete by the quest, then something was omitted.. most likely the finishing the exact course by foot... to Menethil

Good questing to you all

The quest consists of going through the first set of tunnels from Loch Modan in the direction of the Wetlands. Just after the first tunnel your path will be blocked by mobs of Dragonmaw Scout Mobs. These are the mobs you must kill to complete the quest. Deeper in that cove that appears to be a small base are where the Dragonmaw grunts are. This quest is not hard just take your time. I did it easily with my 19 warrior...but then again..he is a lil bit twinked.
you just go throught the 4 tunnels from loch modan to wetland then it will shows you complete the Q..

Manage your pulls, and this is incredibly easy to solo, quite possibly a little moreso as a rogue (done at lv 21 with my rogue Yume). Use every trick in the book, climb up walls to do long range pulls, body pull, use any crowd control you have, and you should be [i]fine[/i].

I solo'd this as a level 19 Warlock fairly quickly.

At the main camp of Orcs in Algaz (between two tunnels), I pulled and killed the scouts one-by-one no problem. To get the Orcs I snuck around the perimeter of the camps and pulled the ones closest to me. The idea is not to wake up anyone in the middle of the camp. The respawn is fairly quick, so you can do it again shortly afterwards.

I forgot bout this quest for a while, but I managed it fiiine as lvl 25 hunter... T'is pretty damn easy, plenty of grunts n scouts about, if you can't find thum tho use the tracking thingy (: (if you have it ofcourse...)
I never go into the camp.  Just before you enter the fence go right up the hill.  There are many grunts and scouts well spaced.  Soloed easily with my 20 NE priest.

A clarification on the "Traverse Dun Algaz" issue.  I killed the mobs I needed and hearthed back to Menethil immediately after.  I then realized that to complete it I would need to actually walk the tunnels.  If you just enter the first tunnel on the Wetlands side of Dun Algaz, you'll satisfy the "traverse" portion of the quest.  No need to go through the entire path again.  Just walk in that door and back out and you'll be alright.

Location is going from Loch Moden to the Wetlands, they are off to the left hand side.
replies:
this quest is actually very, very easy. i soloed it with a 20 druid

where to find them? if you take the route up from loch modan you pass them no questions, they are on the left, theres a little ravine down there.

my advice is: as you go down this first ravine, you'll see a treetrunk connecting the 2 walls, 1 either side. it is possible (may take 1 or 2 attempts) to get on the trunk. from there, you can follow the top of the hills along, still killing as you go. when you see the building full of them, simply go to the side (east i think) and carry on out the place. quest complete!

comments.body: Soloed quest with my level 19 Druid.  You can easily pull one at a time.  As a Druid, I can take on two, if I stay in bear form.  If you want to fight the Grunts and not go all the way into the camp, go up the hill to your right (just where you're entering the camp).  Some will be on guard up there, along with Scouts.  So far I've seen only two Grunts on ground level, near the camp entrance.  Found three up on those hills.  Another one is perched on a hill to the left of the camp entrance.  May fluctuate, but so far it's been the same each time I've gone in there.  By the time you get the ones on the hill, you'll go down and see that the others have respawned.
This small area full of orcs is great for leveling up quickly (at lvls 17, 18 and 19) as the respawn rate is supa-fast, also they are a peice of piss to down.
